::: {.home-section .research-agenda}
<p class="section-kicker">Research agenda</p>

## Economics for consequential transitions

<p class="section-intro">My research combines applied microeconomics, structural models, field experiments, and administrative data to understand the forces reshaping low- and middle-income economies.</p>

::: {.agenda-grid}
::: {.agenda-item}
<span class="agenda-number">01</span>

### Climate adaptation and human capital

How education and mobility determine who can adapt to a changing climate—and why climate damages are distributed so unequally.
:::

::: {.agenda-item}
<span class="agenda-number">02</span>

### Energy markets and state capacity

How contracts, prices, metering, and enforcement shape the reliability and affordability of electricity systems.
:::

::: {.agenda-item}
<span class="agenda-number">03</span>

### Structural transformation and technology

How industrial policy, artificial intelligence, and changing sectoral capabilities alter the path from poverty to prosperity.
:::
:::
:::

<p class="section-kicker">From evidence to policy</p>

## Research that travels into the policy room

I advise governments and public institutions on energy reform, public finance, and growth strategy. Recent work has supported senior decision-makers in Pakistan and Ethiopia, while my role at the IGC connects research teams with policy partners across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.

[Explore policy work →](policy.qmd){.text-link-arrow}
